mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a 0.5pp rise over 3 months, signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing activity that will weigh on economic growth and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 for 2 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) decline by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a weakening housing market that will drag on consumer spending and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y HOUST growth declines by >10pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and payroll employment (PAYEMS) both decline for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening labor market that will boost wage growth and support positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline for 2 consecutive months but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) rises by more than 3% year-over-year for three consecutive months, it signals a persistent inflationary environment that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL Y/Y growth > 3% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL Y/Y growth > 3% for 3 consecutive months but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >40% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real consumer spending (RSAFS) declines by more than 2% month-over-month, and the S&P 500 is already down more than 5% from its 52-week high, it signals a bearish regime shift that will lead to further negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines > 2% M/M and SPX < -5% from 52-week high
failure_condition: RSAFS declines > 2% M/M and SPX < -5% from 52-week high but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.
